texts.en:
We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.

texts.en:
We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on [primitive_civ.Capital.GetName] in the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName] system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

We should consider building an Observation Post above their world to study them more closely.
